field.description: Acknowledge the persistent downstream-impact notice after checking affected routers.
Loading allocator proposals.
No interface selected.
Select an eligible Track6 interface with active Kea DHCPv6.
Allocator upstream prefix and pool length.
IPv6 address of the Kea delegation pool, without a CIDR length.
Prefix length of the complete Kea PD pool. Kea delegates this complete prefix to one downstream router.
I understand that changing an existing delegated prefix may require DHCPv6-PD renewal or manual reconfiguration on downstream routers.
Explicitly authorize DGPD to manage this interface. Existing native PD assignments remain protected.
Copy the displayed allocator proposal into Delegated PD and Delegated Length, replacing your edits. This does not save, reserve a prefix, or change services. Apply checks availability again.
Validate and stage the assignment. Use Save Settings below to commit it.
Save the staged assignment, verify the live Kea pool, and finalize DGPD status.
Disable the native PD pool while retaining the DGPD reservation. An active owned IA_PD lease is revoked only after a downstream-interruption warning is confirmed.
Revalidate and restore a disabled reservation.

Remove the native PD pool and release the DGPD reservation. Warning: Active IA_PD leases in this DGPD-owned pool will be revoked. This interrupts downstream prefix delegation and may require renewal or manual reconfiguration.
Recover a saved operation after resolving a failure. This does not reset assignments or remove leases.
Revalidate and restore the saved DGPD assignment.
Accept a fully validated, upstream-contained and collision-free native Kea PD change as the new DGPD assignment.
Release the DGPD reservation while leaving the current native DHCPv6 configuration unchanged.

• Propose
    • Copy a free, unreserved candidate into the editor without saving it.
  • Apply Assignment
    • Validate and stage the displayed assignment.
  • Save Settings
    • Save the staged operation and verify the live Kea pool.
  • Disable
    • Remove the native pool and retain the DGPD reservation.
  • Enable
    • Revalidate and restore a disabled reservation.
  • Delete
    • Remove the native pool and release its DGPD reservation.
  • Recover
    • Restore Save Settings for an interrupted pending operation.
  • Acknowledge Notice
    • Confirm that the persistent downstream impact notice was reviewed.
  • Restore DGPD Assignment
    • Replace an external native change with the saved DGPD assignment.
  • Accept Native Change
    • Adopt a validated, upstream-contained, collision-free native assignment.
  • Release Ownership
    • Stop managing the assignment without changing native DHCPv6 settings.
